transfer.stem: 换成灯笼、卡片和旧小提琴，哪组三句保留全部信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
这个灯笼是用再生纸做的。我们折卡片时放着轻柔的音乐。旧小提琴需要在演出前调音。
词语提示：lantern灯笼；fold折叠；tuning调音。

options.text: The lantern was made from recycled paper. Soft music played while we folded the cards. The old violin needs tuning before the show.
The lantern was made from new plastic. Soft music played while we folded the cards. The old violin needs tuning before the show.
The lantern was made from recycled paper. Soft music played after we folded the cards. The old violin needs tuning before the show.
The lantern was made from recycled paper. Soft music played while we folded the cards. The old violin needs tuning after the show.

answer.display: The lantern was made from recycled paper. Soft music played while we folded the cards. The old violin needs tuning before the show.

explanation.strategy: 先核对材料，再看两件事是否同时发生，最后保留需要调音与演出的先后。

steps.reason: needs tuning是需要调音，before是演出之前，不表示已经调好。

picturePurpose: The original violin/guitar image provides two clear equipment-identification targets. Code-owned diagrams teach material direction, overlapping time, relative volume, circle/line formation and broken-string counts. The hard-case fact comes from text; the image does not depict a source case or broken string. A timeline and exact evidence selection preserve need-before-concert and the remembered first school trip.
